claim_notes: Attribution: Aniskevich Andrey and Bulderberga Olga (2023), Characterisation of mechanical properties of materials used in 3D printing, Zenodo dataset, version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8089569; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8089568. Creator order and spelling follow the Zenodo version record.

Only sparse reference-filament measurements and identification cells are curated. Numeric XML lexical values are preserved without changing or recalculating them; source text is organized and summarized into catalog fields. The raw workbook, images, full worksheets and extensive prose are excluded.

record.title: MakerBot Launches METHOD Materials Development Program
claim_notes: The 2019-11-19 MakerBot announcement, hosted by parent Stratasys, explicitly identifies KIMYA ABS ESD as an ABS-based material containing carbon nanotubes. The named product is ABS ESD, not ABS EC.
This is primary manufacturer-platform partner documentation about a KIMYA product, not a KIMYA-authored datasheet or a specimen-specific composition measurement.

The separately inspected 2025 Airtech Kimya ABS-ESD SDS does not list a complete recipe or substantiate carbon nanotubes; it neither replaces nor independently confirms the 2019 constituent statement. The 2019-to-study-lot applicability remains qualified.

Only the brief constituent/classification fact is used. Filler loading, purity, complete formulation, numerical manufacturer properties, printing conditions and equivalence across product revisions are not inferred.
Original HTML SHA-256: a4c3fcb04c9a77ec7296be2d31211eb17e6fe14c14eb490e90d339a64dbce6b7. Source content remains external-only; no open reuse license is assigned.
